en: A black-and-white image of a large crowd gathered in front of a Gothic-style building, likely a town hall or cathedral. The crowd consists of people in religious or ceremonial clothing, and there appears to be an altar or stage set up in front of the building. The architectural details are ornate, with pointed arches and tracery, typical of Central European Gothic architecture. The event seems to be a religious procession or outdoor mass.
